caption: The drawing depicts a metal lantern with a cylindrical, ribbed body and a rounded top. A hook is attached at the top of the lantern for hanging. The front portion of the lantern is cut away to show a large, horizontally ribbed lens or glass component colored in green. The lantern has vertical black bars positioned in front of the glass. Above the lens, a small plaque or label with the word "STARBOARD" is affixed to the housing. The entire lantern is outlined in black ink, and shading lines are used for depth. The background is plain and uncolored, and the primary colors in the drawing are black for lines and outlines, and green for the ribbed lens.
title: Ship Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
